final_message: Products already ran npm ci when their worktrees were created. PJR-CM5W had no tracked lock at that point and nothing was logged, so a skip log was added to installWorktreeDependencies. Added an integration test (fake npm on PATH; not run in the sandbox, left to the parent runner) checking that npm ci runs for a product with a lock and is skipped with a log for one without. Added a dependency installation row to the current implementation boundaries table in docs-structure-guide and filled in the ticket's resolution section. Remaining limitation: reused worktrees do not reinstall dependencies, same as the project side.
